tools.name: scan_domain
tools.description: Read a product's website and return its ideal customer profile, a first cold email and the best-fit companies scored 1-10. Takes about 30 seconds.

tools.name: import_leads
tools.description: Clean your own list (CSV text with an email column, optional company, name, website) into leads: drops invalid, duplicate, already-emailed, public-sector, role-mailbox (info@, support@) and no-mail-server addresses, and says why. A list that is mostly unmailable is refused whole. Requires confirmOwn

tools.name: get_email_allowance
tools.description: How many outreach emails are left this month on the plan.

tools.name: export_outreach
tools.description: Everyone this account has emailed, as CSV: email, company, contact, product, subject, delivery, replied, reply category.

tools.name: list_sending_domains
tools.description: The account's sending domains and managed GrowFast address, with remaining sends today.

tools.name: list_autopilots
tools.description: Every autopilot on the account (one per product) with its last result.

tools.name: set_autopilot
tools.description: Create or change the autopilot for one product and turn it on or off. Each day it finds new fits (8/10 or better), writes to the decision-maker and sends within the daily limit.

tools.name: send_reply
tools.description: Send the founder's answer to a prospect who replied, in the same thread, from the address they wrote to.

tools.name: list_reddit_monitors
tools.description: The Reddit monitors on the account, one per product.

tools.name: set_reddit_monitor
tools.description: Set what to listen for on Reddit for one product. Replaces that product's existing monitor settings. GrowFast finds posts where the author needs the product and drafts a reply and DM; the founder posts them.

tools.name: list_reddit_matches
tools.description: Reddit posts found for a product, best first, with drafted replies.

tools.name: draft_outreach_emails
tools.description: For up to 10 companies (for example from scan_domain), find the named decision-maker on each company's own site and write a first email to them. Nothing is sent and nothing is saved: the founder reads and edits the drafts. Takes 10-60 seconds.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_domain, import_leads, get_email_allowance, list_reddit_matches · Private data: import_leads, export_outreach · Public sink: scan_domain, import_leads, get_email_allowance, export_outreach, send_reply, draft_outreach_emails.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_domain, import_leads, get_email_allowance, list_reddit_matches · Private data: import_leads, export_outreach · Public sink: scan_domain, import_leads, get_email_allowance, export_outreach, send_reply, draft_outreach_emails

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
